media.alt: AKUH, Karachi, wins 8th EFP/ILO award on best practices

content.text: Aga Khan University Hospital has won Occupational Safety Health Award . The Award Distribution Ceremony was held on Saturday, April 27, 2013 at Pearl Continental Hotel, Karachi on the occasion of World Day on Occupational Safety and Health at Work. The award ceremony was arranged by the Employers' Federation of Pakistan in collaboration with the International Labour Organization (ILO).

The criteria of the competition, announced on the national level, included the quality of EHS Management Program, Leadership Commitment, Staff Participation, Goals and Objectives, Training Programs and Progress, EHS Departmental Setup, Incident Reporting and Analysis, Emergency Preparedness, Employee Health Monitoring Program, and Performance Monitoring, Measurement and Improvement.

Relevant data and record for the year 2011 and 2012 was collected from various organizations and analyzed/compared to identify award winners. Organizations representing various sectors submitted their nominations. AKU was judged, by an independent panel of judges, to exhibit the outstanding OSHE performance in the service sector.
